svg.desc: Public development only; final independent benchmark failed; no final winner. CPython, C, Rust, and Zig ran the same 8192 calibration-only public cases, 13 paired trials, and 2000 bootstrap draws. Every frozen operation and category; geometric means only, not category confidence intervals. Final speed, final memory, and final candidate ranking: NOT MEASURED. Final winner: NONE.
